title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements Terms — Handover Appointment Reschedules and the Card Allowance
content:
**Term.** On an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements paid in cash or through an outside lender, a reschedule reduction is taken off the order's card allowance according to the customer's own reschedules of the order's handover appointment, as counted on that appointment in Delivery & Pickup Appointments.

| Customer reschedules of the handover appointment | Reduction taken off the card allowance |
|---|---|
| two or more | $500.00 (the repeat-reschedule reduction) |
| one | $250.00 (the single-reschedule reduction) |
| none | none |

**Boundary.** One reschedule takes off $250.00; the second takes the reduction to $500.00; a third or later reschedule leaves it at $500.00.

**Hypothetical cases.** A card allowance of $5850.00 before this reduction stands at $5850.00 with no reschedule, $5600.00 after one and $5350.00 after two or more.
